format: S6S1 little endian: header <4sIIQ>; each row has eight bytes [left length, seven input letters], uint32 count, then sorted (uint16 coordinate,int64 coefficient) pairs. Coordinates are F4 odd admissible weight seven lexicographically, followed by exact-depth-five coordinates. Divide coefficients by the header denominator.
scope: Lossless encoding checks every coefficient, input, support count, depth and round-trip integer pair. Raw generated JSON retained unchanged in scratch; no input coordinate discarded. This is evidence integrity, not rational target membership.
